title: Temu listPrice — sandbox live capture (Step 1)
methods: curl static HTML (US search, CA category, US PDP) + jsdom selector probe
Playwright Chromium 140 headless renders (fresh unauthenticated contexts)
Workspace fetch of temu.com search URL

staticHtml.result: JS shell only on all three URLs: 0 anchors, 0 imgs, 0 goodContainer, 0 [data-type=price]/[priceText], 0 del/s, no JSON-LD.
i18nEvidence: a11y string: "Original price {0}" (en store, key originalPrice) — appears in search and goods bundles

linePriceExplain: "Items on Temu.com may display a strikethrough price, which is the manufacturer's suggested retail price ... or the price provided by the merchandise partners ... a reference price for price comparison purposes."
minPrice/maxPrice hits were only search-filter input labels (minPriceInput/maxPriceInput), not product data
marketPrice/listPrice keys: 0 occurrences; no SSR product payload in static HTML

successfulRender.surface: US home feed (https://www.temu.com/), first navigation of a fresh context, 2026-10-21
successfulRender.reading: Selling price renders per card in [data-type=price] (value duplicated: accessible + visual text). [data-type=priceText] is NOT a per-card struck price in this render — its single occurrence carries promo text. No del/s anywhere. The current extractTemuPricing list-price candidate pool on such cards is therefore empty or unparseable => listPrice null (plan section 7, branch 1/2), consistent with the owner-reported always-null symptom on cards.
successfulRender.caveat: Whether these feed cards visibly showed a struck price to a human, and whether search/category/PDP use a different rendering, could not be observed: every subsequent render was login- or verification-walled (final attempt: /bgn_verification.html "Security verification", not bypassed per product rules). The serialized HTML of the successful render was overwritten by a later login-page capture; the counts/samples above are from the live in-page probe of that render.

ownerEvidence.reading: The failure is observed live on Temu Canada category pages with the extension active. The [PPHunt][Temu][Diagnostics] listPrice lines live in the service-worker console, not the page console; owner capture instructions are in the Step-1 summary doc.

verdicts.G0: PARTIAL from sandbox. Card-side mechanism established for the one rendered surface (candidate pool empty/unparseable under the assumed contract). Search/category/PDP live node shapes still unobserved due to login/verification walls; closing them requires the owner capture (service-worker diagnostics lines + in-page probe) or an authenticated manual collection with the SAD-360 harness.
verdicts.G1_discountPrice: No third distinct price observed in any capture (each price node carried one value, duplicated). Per the owner's locked fallback (only-two-prices => drop), discountPrice is DROPPED for this ticket; reopen only if owner capture shows a distinct third displayed price.
verdicts.implementationBasis: Proceed with (a) code-provable fixes F1-F5/F7-F9 (PDP two-scope list-price search, >price rule, srOnly labelled-segment parsing, unified reference-price vocabulary incl. aria scan, candidate-pool instead of first-match, precise diagnostics) and (b) a presentation-semantic fallback inside the existing price scope: a currency-bearing struck (line-through) leaf strictly above the selling price — justified by Temu's own measured terminology ('strikethrough price' / 'Original price {0}'), hash-free, impostor-filtered. No new site-specific selector is invented.

limitations: No authenticated Temu session in sandbox; search/category/PDP could not be rendered.
One successful render only (home feed); feed cards may differ from search/category cards.
GBP/EUR locale rendering not captured; CA was login/verification-walled from sandbox.
